observations.observation: LogTape is a zero-dependency TypeScript logging library with structured records, configurable sinks, and synchronous or ordered asynchronous sink adapters across Node.js and edge runtimes.
observations.freshnessScope: Official documentation landing page at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: A repository-specific redaction policy still has to be implemented and reviewed.

observations.observation: pgAudit writes detailed PostgreSQL session and object statement audit entries through the standard PostgreSQL logging facility and requires shared_preload_libraries configuration.
observations.freshnessScope: Official pgAudit README for PostgreSQL 14 through 19 at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: Database statement logs do not by themselves supply the requested application authorization outcome schema.

observations.observation: Pino is a Node.js JSON logger whose official documentation includes redaction, child loggers, transports, and asynchronous logging.
observations.freshnessScope: Official Pino documentation index and runtime statement at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: Retention durability remains the responsibility of the existing container log collector.

observations.observation: Winston accepts structured info objects and provides JSON formatting plus console, file, and HTTP transports with per-transport formats.
observations.freshnessScope: Official repository README at the evidence cutoff.
observations.limitation: Redaction requires a deliberately configured format rather than a case-specific built-in policy.
